# IPinfo: integration analysis

> Generated by API Integration Scout from <https://ipinfo.io/developers> on 2026-10-07T08:35:30.516Z.
> Every finding is marked **Documented** (quoted from the docs and verified), **Inferred** (the agent's reasoning) or **Not found in docs**.

IPinfo is a REST API for IP intelligence: geolocation, ASN, anonymity/hosting flags, company, and related data for IPv4/IPv6 addresses. It has tiers (Lite free, Core, Plus, Max), a batch endpoint, and a legacy API on ipinfo.io. Database downloads are also offered.

## At a glance

| Area | Finding | Status | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Base URL | https://api.ipinfo.io | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Authentication | bearer: Bearer token in Authorization header. (+2 documented alternatives) | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Pagination | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Rate limits | Lite unlimited; paid plans have a monthly request quota; no daily/hourly caps, concurrency limits, or per-second throttling on paid plans. | Documented | [/developers](https://ipinfo.io/developers) |
| Webhooks | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Error format | — | Not found in docs | — |
| Versioning | other | Inferred | [/developers/core-api](https://ipinfo.io/developers/core-api) |
| Endpoints | 4 found | 4 documented, 0 inferred | — |

## Risks

- **MEDIUM**: Two API generations. Updated (api.ipinfo.io) and legacy (ipinfo.io) have different response shapes; pick one deliberately.
- **MEDIUM**: Free tokens can't use /lookup. Free tokens get an error on /lookup and default /batch; use /lite and /batch/lite.
- **MEDIUM**: Token in query string. The token can leak in logs and URLs; prefer the Bearer header server-side. JSONP/CORS use exposes tokens in client code.
- **LOW**: Error format undocumented. Only 429 is mentioned; error bodies are not described in the fetched pages.
- **LOW**: Page truncation. Some fetched pages were truncated, so details may be missing.
